metadata.description: Free Claude Code plugins from Alex Tong — skills for AI-assisted development and printable educational worksheets.

plugins.name: alex-tong-workspace
plugins.description: Create and audit multi-repo workspaces with shared context — for teams or personal projects. Generates repo registry, CLAUDE.md scaffold, Makefile, and bootstrap scripts.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: PR workflow skills — generate structured PR descriptions from your branch diff.

plugins.name: education
plugins.description: Educational content skills — create beautiful, printable worksheets as self-contained HTML files for any grade level, subject, or audience.

plugins.name: claude-brain
plugins.description: Claude Code context quality skills — audit CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/ files for staleness, contradictions, and missing context.

plugins.name: company-research
plugins.description: Research a company comprehensively — culture, WLB, leadership, comp — with an optional role-specific interview deep-dive (stages, hiring manager, common questions, prep frameworks). Output is a saved markdown packet.

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: Locally track which Claude Code skills and agents you actually invoke — surface the top hits and the ones you installed but never use.

plugins.name: context-diet
plugins.description: Audit what actually loads into every Claude Code session at startup — CLAUDE.md files, plugins, skills, subagents, MCP servers — with per-source token estimates and prune recommendations.
